address: SAT2-SAT3: 9554 Westover Hills Boulevard, San Antonio, TX 78251
SAT4: 9655 Raba Drive, San Antonio, TX 78251

reading.body:
The SAT2-SAT4 campus publishes 36 MW of IT capacity spread across three buildings and roughly 295,000 square feet of technical space on two adjacent parcels in San Antonio's Westover Hills area. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 36 MW supports approximately 900 racks; at 10 kW per rack, a more typical enterprise density, the same load supports roughly 3,600 racks. The operator publishes no breakdown of capacity by building, so the 36 MW figure cannot be attributed to SAT2, SAT3, or SAT4 individually.

The certifications qualify the campus to host regulated workloads across several regimes. PCI DSS covers payment-card data environments. HIPAA qualifies the site for health information under that federal framework. ISO 27001 certifies an information security management system. FISMA positions the campus for certain federal or federally adjacent workloads. SSAE 16 Type II documents controls through a third-party audit. TIA-942 is a data center infrastructure standard whose tier is not specified in the published data.

Among the 133 data center facilities this site has mapped in Texas, only 8 publish a megawatt figure, and their combined published total is 315 MW. At 36 MW, this campus ranks fourth among those eight by published IT load, representing roughly 11 percent of the published Texas total this site has read. That ranking reflects only what operators have chosen to publish, not total installed capacity across the state.
